name: Engazy for WooCommerce
author: insightsmafia

sections.description:
Engazy sends WhatsApp messages for your WooCommerce orders on Meta’s official WhatsApp Business Platform, from your own WhatsApp Business number:

  • Order confirmation as soon as an order is placed.
  • Cash on delivery check with Confirm and Cancel buttons. Confirm adds a note to the order; Cancel cancels it (WooCommerce puts the stock back).
  • Shipped, out for delivery and delivered updates, with the tracking link from the Shipment Tracking plugin when you use it.
  • Cancelled and refunded updates.
  • Abandoned-checkout reminders: when a customer types a phone number at checkout but doesn’t order, a reminder with a link that refills their cart, and an optional second reminder with a one-time discount code.
  • “Where is my order?” answers on WhatsApp, only ever with the customer’s own orders.
  • Replies land in Engazy’s shared team inbox.

Engazy writes the WhatsApp templates for these messages, in English or Hindi, and submits them to Meta for you. You pay Meta’s own message rates, with no markup.

What this plugin adds

Orders, shipping and refunds work as soon as the store is connected from Engazy. This plugin adds what WooCommerce doesn’t have on its own:

  • An optional “Send me order updates on WhatsApp” checkbox at checkout, on both the Checkout block and the classic checkout. It is off by default: order updates go to the phone number the customer gives at checkout. Turn it on in WooCommerce → Engazy if you want customers to tick a box; then only those who tick it get messages.
  • Abandoned checkouts: the checkout is reported to Engazy once a phone number is typed, so Engazy can remind the customer. The reminder’s link refills their cart and applies the one-time code if the reminder has one.
  • A one-click Connect button that opens Engazy with your store’s address filled in.

You need an Engazy account (free plan available) and a WhatsApp Business number connected in Engazy.

External services

This plugin connects to Engazy (https://engazy.co), a service operated by Insights Mafia, New Delhi, India. Nothing is sent until the store owner connects the store from Engazy.

  • When a store is connected, Engazy calls this plugin’s REST route (authenticated with the WooCommerce REST API keys the store owner approved) to save the store’s Engazy id, a signing secret and the Engazy address it reports checkouts to.
  • During checkout, once the customer has typed a phone number, the plugin sends Engazy the phone number, first name, cart items, cart total, currency, whether the WhatsApp box is ticked and a link that refills the cart. This is used for abandoned-checkout reminders.
  • Orders reach Engazy through WooCommerce’s own webhooks, which Engazy adds when the store is connected.

Engazy Terms of Service: https://engazy.co/terms
Engazy Privacy Policy: https://engazy.co/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin (Plugins → Add New → search “Engazy”).
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Engazy and press Connect this store in Engazy. Sign in to Engazy (or create a free account).
  3. Approve Engazy on the WooCommerce screen that opens. The Engazy page in WordPress now shows “Connected”.
  4. In Engazy → Settings → Integrations, pick the ready-made messages and approve them. Each one starts once Meta approves its template.

WooCommerce’s REST API needs pretty permalinks (Settings → Permalinks → anything but “Plain”).
sections.faq:
Do my customers have to agree to WhatsApp messages?

WhatsApp only allows business messages to people who agreed to them. By default Engazy treats the phone number given at your checkout as agreement to order updates (Engazy → Settings → Integrations → “My checkout tells customers they’ll get WhatsApp updates”, on by default; say so in your checkout or store policies). If you prefer an explicit checkbox, turn it on in WooCommerce → Engazy. A customer who replies STOP gets no more messages.

Does it work with the Checkout block?

Yes, and with the classic checkout shortcode. The Checkout block needs WooCommerce 8.9 or later for the checkbox.

What does it cost?

The plugin is free. Engazy has a free plan and paid plans (see https://engazy.co/pricing). WhatsApp messages are charged by Meta at its own rates.

Is Engazy an official WhatsApp provider?

Engazy uses only Meta’s official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), never unofficial WhatsApp Web tools.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • The checkout checkbox is now optional and off by default: order updates go to the phone number given at checkout. Turn the box on in WooCommerce → Engazy.
  • The Connect button goes straight to WooCommerce’s approve screen.
  • Cleans up its settings when deleted.

1.1.0

  • Checkout block support: the WhatsApp checkbox and abandoned-checkout reports work on the block checkout too.

1.0.0

  • First release.
